g.text: RK3568 endpoints: T28/T27 TX+/-; R28/R27 RX+/-; P27/P28 DP/DM; M24 VBUSDET needs its own sensing circuit.

g.desc: RK3568 endpoints: T28/T27 TX+/-; R28/R27 RX+/-; P27/P28 DP/DM; M24 VBUSDET needs its own sensing circuit.

g.text: USB_MUX_ENABLE_N must default disabled until main SoC supplies are valid.

g.desc: USB_MUX_ENABLE_N must default disabled until main SoC supplies are valid.

g.text: Require CC_OUT1_N=0 AND CC_OUT2_N=0 for the proposed 3 A startup policy; OUT2 alone is insufficient.

g.desc: Require CC_OUT1_N=0 AND CC_OUT2_N=0 for the proposed 3 A startup policy; OUT2 alone is insufficient.

g.text: Sources: TI HD3SS3220 SLLSES1E, TPD4EUSB30 SLVSA29K; Rockchip Hardware Design Guide V1.2.

g.desc: Sources: TI HD3SS3220 SLLSES1E, TPD4EUSB30 SLVSA29K; Rockchip Hardware Design Guide V1.2.

g.text: Power circuitry is NOT included: VBUS protection, inrush, +3V3_AON and load gating remain required.

g.desc: Power circuitry is NOT included: VBUS protection, inrush, +3V3_AON and load gating remain required.

g.text: Sink/UFP only, GPIO mode: PORT=GND, ADDR=NC. No USB Power Delivery negotiation.

g.desc: Sink/UFP only, GPIO mode: PORT=GND, ADDR=NC. No USB Power Delivery negotiation.

g.text: USB-C DATA FRONTEND - ENGINEERING DRAFT, NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: USB-C DATA FRONTEND - ENGINEERING DRAFT, NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: USB_SHIELD termination and connector footprint remain to validate. Passive MPNs are not selected.

g.desc: USB_SHIELD termination and connector footprint remain to validate. Passive MPNs are not selected.

g.text: USB_CC_ENABLE_N requires verified VDD5/VCC33 sequencing (TI section 6.3.12, >=2 ms when controlled).

g.desc: USB_CC_ENABLE_N requires verified VDD5/VCC33 sequencing (TI section 6.3.12, >=2 ms when controlled).

g.text: TX AC coupling is on the connector side of the mux, following TI UFP reference. No duplicate SoC TX capacitors.

g.desc: TX AC coupling is on the connector side of the mux, following TI UFP reference. No duplicate SoC TX capacitors.
